status: Current C++ source index; generated parameter values are in each run resolved.json/effective_full.json
model_path_rule: Feature config paths are relative to the main pipeline.json directory; SDK/profile internal paths are relative to their containing file. Weights are centralized in models/x5 and models/cpu. models/manifest.json is inventory only.
intrinsics_rule: camera reads rectified intrinsics from SDK; ROS defaults to same-stamp CameraInfo; offline/recording geometry (cloud or disparity) requires explicit intrinsics_file relative to main pipeline.json. The file is a standalone intrinsics object or recorder metadata.json with nested intrinsics.

entries.configuration: pipeline.json: graph.worker_threads; graph.nodes id, feature, algorithm, inputs, depends_on, enabled
entries.inference_contract: feature=inference algorithm=det|seg|stereo selects independently scheduled algorithm instances. det/seg inputs.image=input.left; stereo inputs.left=input.left, inputs.right=input.right. Bindings are fixed validated contracts, not arbitrary JSON plugin ports. Legacy inference without algorithm remains supported; cannot mix it with det/seg instances.
entries.disparity_contract: effective_full.json input.disparity_source freezes raft_stereo or original_q8. raft_stereo requires left/right and a provider even if Q8 was supplied; original_q8 requires genuine supplied Q8 and does not run the model or require right. Legacy SDK JSON without input keeps auto behavior.
entries.dependency_contract: cloud waits for disparity only; labels waits for cloud and every enabled semantic lane. history, publish and record join all enabled producer ancestors. RGB conversion is lazy and cached; explicit rgb node is optional legacy compatibility.
entries.worker_contract: Product graph workers schedule independent model instances. Generated single-lane internal DAGs use one worker each; this does not guarantee BPU hardware concurrency.
